environment.client_shape: Codex 0.162.0-alpha.17.2 against a synthetic loopback server; no upstream inference

checks.detail: All24 package tests passed, including five nested failure cases. Coverage includes existing native routing/auth/error behavior, opt-in Messages metadata, roles and tool results, namespace and freeform tools, purpose-separated authenticated thinking state, incremental SSE, stable event/item IDs, upstream usage, unsupported-input rejection, upstream429 preservation and incomplete tools not dispatched as completed calls.

limitations: This evidence contains offline synthetic checks only. It is not proof of account entitlement, all-model live behavior or target GUI acceptance.

The Messages adapter implements a bounded subset, not full Responses equivalence: hosted tools, structured output, forced tool choice, server-side conversation state and remote compaction are unsupported.
Claude thinking is preserved as encrypted opaque state, not shown as an answer or used to claim visible reasoning-summary support. Key rotation or a different model requires a new conversation.
Images are limited to inline base64 conversion; current catalog entries do not infer vision entitlement from historical tests.
The existing external relay/runtime and legacy gateway dependency installation were not changed by this adapter work. No full legacy dependency-gate success is claimed.
Prior evidence files retain their original bytes under historical classification; no historical success was rewritten to cover the new converter.
